title: Lab streaming upload
description: Node.js 24 runtime lesson: A service accepts an upload as a single unbounded buffer, letting large requests exhaust memory and suppressing useful integrity information. Includes executable core-module fixtures, a failing starter and instructor regression suite.
objectives: Hash the incoming stream incrementally using node:crypto and enforce a strict byte ceiling before retaining or persisting any bytes.
Repair node-streaming-upload and prove a failure boundary.
Describe production risks not exercised by the local Node test.
rubric: I can explain the Node runtime contract for lab streaming upload.
I can reproduce and repair 10.01.08 with real Node core modules.
I can identify a security or load test needed before deployment.
